creator: Alexander Terp
description: devenv/devenv defaults to up (case "${1:-up}"), and up recreates the shared muster-devenv container with the calling worktree's key. Running it bare to see its usage destroyed the container another worktree was using (2026-09-27). With no argument it should print its usage and exit, like ./dev -h.
title: ./devenv/devenv with no arguments recreates the container
